title: Otori Emu — Building Our Candy Town♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see Miku and the others' show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They really startled us when they suddenly appeared on our phones and asked us to come to SEKAI immediately. To think that they had a surprise show planned for us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on the introduction KAITO just gave a second ago, their show just happens to have the same Christmas theme as the one we're going to be doing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... It's supposed to be about a girl who does her best to perform good deeds so that Santa Claus brings her a present, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to seeing if she actually gets one...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me too.
And we'll just have to watch the show to find out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's starting...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Oh, someone must've dropped this pencil...!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “If I return this to its owner, then Santa will have to say that I performed a good deed!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “The owner's name is... Anna.”
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Oh, you there!
Do you know anyone named Anna?”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “Anna? She's right over there.”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “I actually want to become friends with her, but I'm too scared to say anything. If only I had an excuse to go and talk to her...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“I see...
Then, why don't you give her this pencil? I think it belongs to her!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “This could be your ticket to becoming friends with her...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Oh, she's giving him the pencil...!
What a nice girl...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But that also means...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
“I didn't get to perform a good deed...”

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: “Help! My cat's stuck in this tree...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“I'll help!
It's okay, kitty. You'll be fine as long as you come down slowly...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh?! It got down on its own...?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “But it doesn't look hurt at all, and it's acting like nothing happened. Thank goodness...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I couldn't return that pencil, get that cat down or help that old lady with her groceries. What am I doing...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “At this rate, Santa's never going to come visit me... But...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I guess that's fine, since everyone seems really happy...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She's happy that they're all smiling.
What a kind girl...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But is Santa really not gonna come visit her...?)
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Mysterious Old Man
rows.Line: “Ah, you there.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh? Me...?”

rows.Speaker: Mysterious Old Man
rows.Line: “Leave this by your bed for me so that I know where to find you.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh? Um, this big piece of cloth...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, isn't that...?!)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “What is this...? A sock...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Hey, mister, why did you...?
Huh? He's gone...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wait, was he...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“I see...
Santa was watching the whole time.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That was such an amazingly beautiful story!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I was so moved by that girl's kindness!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm just glad Santa Claus saw that she was doing her best to help everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The way she smiled in the end when she received her present made me so happy...☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But why did you guys decide to put on a show for us all the sudden?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because you all said you'd be doing a Christmas show at that ski resort!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We decided to do our own in the hopes that it would help all of you put on a fun show for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We practiced a ton together♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for putting on such an amazing show for us, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I think it was an excellent source of encouragement for all of us. We should be able to put on an especially wonderful performance over there now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's do our best to make all the guests smile from ear to ear☆

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Yes!
